items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: And that's how I first met Lollipop then

ctx.x: Who were some of the stars that came?

Well the stars, Alma Poinel, she was a star, singer-dAncer. Well the stars, Alma Poinnell, she was a star, singer, dancer. Harold was a Deja Jones wife, she was the leader of the chorus girls. And Melford Lewis, a lollipop comedian. Lollipop Jones? Lollipop Jones, yeah. Well I played a show for a lollipop in the early twenties, around twenty-seven or something like that, when he first came here with the Twenty Dots at the Lincoln Theater. See we was the regular band there, for the shows there, shows coming from…
What kind of act would he have?
